what: Provenance for every experimental structure used to build the files in app/public/struct/. All geometry is derived from these deposited cryo-EM models; no coordinates were invented or modelled by us. Show this when the 3D view displays a ribosome.
license: PDB data are freely available (wwPDB; no restrictions on use or redistribution).
attribution_line_short: Human 48S initiation complex, PDB 8PJ1 (Petrychenko et al., Nat Struct Mol Biol 2025) - PDB data are freely available

structures.title: Structure of human 48S translation initiation complex in open codon scanning state (48S-1)
structures.organism: Homo sapiens (all polymer entities annotated Homo sapiens in RCSB; reconstituted in vitro from human components, with a synthetic model mRNA)
structures.contents: 40S small subunit (18S rRNA + 34 protein chains incl. RACK1, eL41 and the ubiquitin moiety of eS31), mRNA (47 nt modelled), initiator Met-tRNAi, eIF1, eIF1A, eIF2 (alpha/beta/gamma), eIF3 (12 subunits: a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h,i,k,l,m)
structures.why_chosen: Human, high resolution, and it is the OPEN CODON-SCANNING state: a 43S/48S pre-initiation complex with mRNA threaded through the 40S channel and the start codon not yet in the P site. That is exactly the state a scanning simulation depicts, and it is the only state in this series where the mRNA is caught mid-scan.
structures.citation: Petrychenko V, Yi SH, Liedtke D, Peng BZ, Rodnina MV, Fischer N. Structural basis for translational control by the human 48S initiation complex. Nat Struct Mol Biol 32:62-72 (2025).
notes: An Author Correction to this paper was published: Nat Struct Mol Biol 33:724 (2026), doi:10.1038/s41594-026-01777-9. We have not read it; check it before quoting figures or numbers from the original paper. It does not affect the deposited coordinates we use.
mRNA residue numbering is the depositors' construct numbering (255-nt entity; residue 0 is skipped), NOT numbering relative to the AUG.
In this state the construct's ACCACC-AUG-G start codon sits at author residues 18-20; only its A (18) and U (19) are modelled, at the 3' (entry-channel) edge of the resolved path.

sibling_states_same_paper.note: The other states of the same pathway, if a later build wants an AUG-recognised or post-hydrolysis frame.

entries.title: AUG recognition state after eIF5-induced GTP hydrolysis by eIF2 (48S-2)
upon transfer of initiator tRNA to eIF5B (48S-3)
after eIF2 release prior to 60S subunit joining (48S-5)
with initiator tRNA, eIF1A and eIF3 (off-pathway)

structures.role: secondary - mRNA entry channel with the eIF4F helicase
structures.title: Structure of a human 48S translation initiation complex with eIF4F and eIF4A
structures.contents: 40S subunit, mRNA (50 nt modelled, author residues 79-128, with the AUG at 106-108), initiator Met-tRNAi, eIF1A, eIF2, eIF3, eIF5, eIF4G1 and TWO copies of eIF4A-I
structures.why_chosen: Included because it shows the mRNA entry channel occupied: in our derived asset the 3'-most modelled mRNA nucleotide lies 10.1 A from an eIF4A-I copy, i.e. the helicase sits directly at the entry channel feeding mRNA in. Useful as the 'mRNA being pulled in' reference.
structures.citation: Brito Querido J, Sokabe M, Diaz-Lopez I, Gordiyenko Y, Fraser CS, Ramakrishnan V. The structure of a human translation initiation complex reveals two independent roles for the helicase eIF4A. Nat Struct Mol Biol 31:455-464 (2024).
notes: eIF1 is not modelled in this entry.
Its asset is in its OWN oriented frame (same convention, recomputed from its own mRNA path and 40S centroid); do not assume the two assets are superimposed.

considered_not_used.title: Structure of a human 48S translational initiation complex
considered_not_used.citation: Brito Querido J, et al. Science 369:1220-1227 (2020). PMID 32883864.
considered_not_used.why_not: Excellent human 48S with eIF4G1/eIF4A, but its modelled mRNA is only 28 nt and is a poly-A stretch, so it reads less well as 'an mRNA being scanned'.

considered_not_used.title: Structure of the human 48S initiation complex in closed state (h48S AUG closed)
considered_not_used.citation: Yi SH, et al. Nucleic Acids Res 50:5282 (2022).
considered_not_used.why_not: Closed (post-AUG-recognition) state; we wanted the scanning state.

considered_not_used.title: Structure of a human ABCE1-bound 43S pre-initiation complex - State III
considered_not_used.citation: Kratzat H, et al. EMBO J 40:e105179 (2021).
considered_not_used.why_not: A genuine native human 43S PIC, but it carries ABCE1 rather than a scanned mRNA.

sources_for_constants: See constants.json; each constant carries its own citation and URL.
scope: This file covers the TRANSLATION assets only (43s.json, 48s_eif4f.json) plus constants.json. Other files in app/public/struct/ (e.g. polii.json, spliceosome.json) were produced by a different pipeline and are NOT documented here; get their provenance from whoever built them before displaying a citation for them.
